description: Ward Nine needs bodies counted at the statue plaza and down Meltwater Row. Nobody will verify the number. Make one up that feels municipal. 12₵.
name: Head Count

emotes: {who} paces the plaza counting heads on their fingers, loses track, starts over.
{who} tallies the loiterers by the statue and rounds up for the ones who left.
{who} counts the figures along Meltwater Row and assigns each a plausible census category.
{who} marks a clipboard, decides the number is close enough for government work.
